title: Persona-Based Simulation of Human Opinion at Population Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the response entropy and distribution variance of LLM agents prompted with demographic-only profiles against behaviorally-grounded personas and human benchmarks to demonstrate the model's over-reliance on broad demographic generalizations rather than reflecting individual heterogeneity.

Comparing the distribution of LLM-simulated survey responses to real human polling data and qualitatively analyzing the generated rationales to show that LLMs systematically prefer to construct complex, mechanistic, and causal explanations rather than employing typical human satisficing heuristics.

Applying iterative proportional fitting (raking) to align the social media-derived persona sample with U.S. Census and ACS demographic margins, and evaluating the differences between unweighted and weighted population-level opinion estimates.
